name: autocare-chain-dashboard
description: AutoCare Chain Dashboard: public booking form + admin panel for a multi-branch car care chain

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,yellow "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
